verdict.rationale: Viam's own materials explicitly claim each element of the story. They list "OTA updates for software and ML models" and "Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning" as fleet capabilities, and say models can be versioned, staged and rolled back "just like code." They also cite remote updates without SSH and Viam-managed module versioning and deployment. However, all of this comes from marketing-level taglines rather than procedural docs. missing for 10: technical documentation of how staged/canary rollouts are configured (e.g., fleet subsets or fragment targeting), documented rollback procedure for viam-server/module software, independent or hands-on corroboration.
